chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar narrated to us from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Sayf ibn Umayra, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:

Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him) used to say to his companions: O children of Adam! Flee from this world to God, and remove your hearts from it, for truly you cannot set it right, nor can it set you right; you will not remain in it, nor will it remain for you. It is the deceiver, the bringer of grief. Deceived is he who is deluded by it. Cheated is he who trusts in it. Destroyed is he who loves it and desires it.

So repent to your Creator, be conscious of your Lord, and fear a Day in which no father will avail his child in the least, nor will any child avail his father in the least. Where are your fathers? Where are your mothers? Where are your brothers? Where are your sisters? Where are your children? They were called and they answered, they were entrusted to the earth, and they became neighbors to the dead, and they joined those who have perished. They departed from this world and parted from their loved ones. They became in need of what they had sent ahead, and became needless of what they left behind.

So how much exhortation have you received, and how much rebuke, while you remain distracted and heedless! Your likeness in this world is like that of cattle — your concern is your stomachs and your private parts. Are you not ashamed before Him who created you?! He has promised the Fire to those who disobey Him, and you are not among those who can withstand the Fire. And He has promised Paradise and His proximity in the Highest Heaven to those who obey Him. So compete for it and be among its people.

Be just with yourselves, be compassionate toward your weak and needy. Repent to God with sincere repentance. Be righteous servants and do not be arrogant kings or among the insolent pharaohs who rebel against Him who overpowers them with death — the Almighty of the almighty, Lord of the heavens and the earths, God of the first and the last, Master of the Day of Judgment, severe in punishment, painful in torment. No oppressor shall escape Him, nothing shall elude Him, nothing is hidden from Him, nothing can conceal itself from Him — His knowledge has encompassed all things, and He will assign each thing to its place in Paradise or in Fire.

O weak child of Adam! Where will you flee from Him who seeks you in the darkness of your night and the brightness of your day and in every condition of yours? He who exhorts has conveyed fully, and he who takes heed will succeed.

key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: This world / worldly life — presented as transient and deceptive
key_terms.الْخَدَّاعَةُ الْفَجَّاعَةُ: The deceiver, the bringer of grief — epithets for the world
key_terms.الْفِرْدَوْسُ الْأَعْلَى: The Highest Heaven (al-Firdaws al-A'la) — the highest level of Paradise
key_terms.تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً: Sincere repentance — repentance that is pure, firm, and does not relapse
key_terms.جَبَّارُ الْجَبَابِرَةِ: The Almighty of the almighty — an epithet emphasizing God's supreme power
key_terms.مَالِكُ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ: Master of the Day of Judgment — echoing Quran 1:4

ai.seo_question: What did Jesus (Isa ibn Maryam) say about the world and renunciation according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This lengthy exhortation presents Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmitting a sermon of Prophet Isa ibn Maryam (Jesus, AS) to his disciples. In it, Jesus warns his followers to detach their hearts from this world, describing it as deceptive and grief-causing, and urges them to repent, fear the Day of Judgment when no one can intercede for another, and compete for Paradise. The hadith was narrated through a chain from al-Shaykh al-Saduq's teacher al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris back to Imam al-Sadiq, who reported Jesus's ongoing practice of delivering this exhortation to his companions — placing this teaching within the Shia tradition of revering all prophets and transmitting their wisdom.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abd al-Jabbar narrated to us from al-Hasan b. `Ali b Abi Hamza from Sayf b. `Amira from Mansur b. Hazim from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as). He said:

`Isa b. Maryam (as) would say to his companions: O children of Adam! Run from this world to Allah, and take your hearts out of it, for surely, you will not fix it, nor will it fix you; you will not remain in it, nor will it remain for you. It is deception and grief. Conceited is he who is deceived by it, dismayed is he who is contented by it, and destroyed is he who loves it and wants it.

Repent to your Maker, be conscious of your Lord, and fear a Day in which a father will not be rewarded on behalf of his son, nor will a son be rewarded on behalf of his father. Where are your fathers, where are your mothers, where are your brothers, where are your sisters, where are your children? They were called back [by your Lord] and were made to answer. They were placed in graves adjacent to the dead and joined the perished ones. They left this world and departed from their loved ones. They became in need of what was placed before them [in the Hereafter] and became needless of what they left behind [in this world].

So, how much exhortation and how much rebuke do you need while you are distracted and heedless?! Your like in this world is like that of the beasts – your concern is over your stomachs and your privates. Are you not ashamed before Him that created you? He has promised the Fire to those who disobey Him, and you are not capable of overpowering the Fire. He has promised Paradise and living in the Highest Heaven to those who obey Him. So, compete for it and be of its people.

Be fair to yourselves. Be gracious to the weak and the needy among you. Repent sincerely to Allah. Be righteous servants, and do not be arrogant kings or haughty pharaohs who oppose Him who conquers them with death – He is the Mighty of the mighty, the Lord of the heavens and the Earths, God of the former and the latter peoples, the Master of the Day of Requital, the stern in reprisal, and the harsh in torment. No oppressor will be delivered from Him, nor does He miss anything, nor is anything left out with Him, nor is anything hidden from Him – His knowledge accounts for all things, and He will place it in Paradise or in the Fire.

O weak child of Adam! Where will you run from Him who seeks you in the darkness of your night, and in the illumination of your day, and in every condition of yours? He who is exhorted becomes informed, and he who gives heed will succeed.
